title: To keep growing, incoming Best Buy CEO says he first wants to go smaller
summary: Jason Bonfig, the incoming CEO of Best Buy, has outlined his strategy for the company's future, emphasizing a focus on smaller store formats. He believes that by going smaller, Best Buy can enhance its customer experience while also expanding its reach. This approach reflects a shift in retail strategy aimed at adapting to changing consumer preferences and market dynamics.
